title: World Generation Probability Cloud
text: Follow the framework’s other evolution through early workshops, the Dream strata and the Spacetime strata. Right-click the Dream gateway to cross. The Spacetime breach carries you through automatically. The framework and JEI show each stage’s offerings.
At the final stage the miniature world collapses into a probability cloud, consuming any remaining materials. Taking the cloud resets the framework.

Use the cloud as an Alchemical Catalysis Chamber substrate, with a Time, Space or Omni Microcore seed and Dilute Spacetime. Each cycle yields four matching microcores, retaining substrate and seed. No natural growth occurs without liquid.
